question: What claim is being made about these figures by classifying them simultaneously as innate, family-born, and all door guardians?
premises: These figures are all door guardians.
inference: The same set of figures is classified under three coextensive categories: innate, family-born, and door guardians.
uncertainties: The identity of this set is not recoverable from this verse alone.
plain_english: All are innate, all are family-born, all are door guardians.
